implementation_design_text:
# Complete M04/M05/M06/M07/M13 measurement design

This packet covers all twelve parent/refinement units and all 96 phase slots. It reuses the completed original source readings from the paused preparation task: 179 routed findings, three external indicator definitions, 208 required PDF pages (107 newly read during preparation), thirteen original Pine sources, the complete 488-line MVF source and four conversation originals. No candidate has run. Original research and prior frozen families remain unchanged.

Implementation files: new measurements/anchored.py, profiles.py, tpo.py and vwap.py; extend footprint.py and, only where needed, the existing literal auction/tape compatibility APIs. Independent primitive reference is references/auction_measurements_literal.py. Tests are tests/test_auction_measurements.py. The shared common.py and measurement_fits.py interfaces are mandatory; no duplicate transaction tape, bar engine or object registry.

## Actual source and anchor admission

Use the exact pinned common capture design and anchored capture design. Direct observations require actual F05 TransactionTapeView or explicitly labeled legacy TradeLedger. Time-bar consumers require capture_bar_window resolving actual retained SharedBarEngine publications and their original WindowRequest. Every detached result is revalidated against its actual producer/recipe at the original cut before consumption. A caller's hash, dataclass or support flag does not prove source availability.

Anchors cover each original RTH, prior RTH, overnight/ETH, Jumbo named range, daily/weekly/monthly/quarter/year, fixed rolling, causal swing/event and composite definition. Actual F03 calendar selections establish named windows; actual F10 anchors establish confirmation and geometry. Retrospective formation can start at an earlier event, but availability is no earlier than actual anchor confirmation and completion. Composite windows deduplicate exact whole-source identities; conflicting revisions or raw contracts reject. Union exposure is computed without counting overlaps twice. Historical windows, source IDs and versions remain immutable. An algorithmic viewport must be frozen and known before its measurement; a final human chart viewport cannot define historical inputs. Display settings do not affect numeric membership or availability.

The common anchored adapter validates actual ObjectGraph get_version plus historical lineage_closure, raw instrument, support/capability and exact definition. Public geometry/target publication goes through that existing graph with full source evidence. It preserves original object birth and fixed TTL through corrections. Profile/side/VWAP Location roles expose separately frozen 5/15/60-minute and actual session-remainder targets through existing V01 object-label contracts; no eventual outcome is a formation feature. Naked references mean no observed touch since confirmed birth under complete coverage; a touch at the next open counts immediately.

## M04 profiles, topology and representation

FrozenGrid defines raw tick origin, positive width, inclusive bounded row range, definition/version and preformation availability. It never expands or shifts from future range information. Out-of-grid low/high mass and unpriced volume are explicit channels. Accumulate nonnegative buy/sell/unknown whole-trade quantities, preserve source members and weighted counts, and reconcile all mass including overflow. Different representations retain different IDs.

Profiles retain all maximum rows and maximal contiguous equal-height plateaus. A scalar POC tie convention is explicit (lower or upper), separate from the full mode set. Contiguous value area starts at that chosen POC and expands by adjacent mass, with declared upper/lower/both tie and empty-gap policy. Report requested versus achieved mass and overshoot. Preserve source 40/68/70-percent choices. The Atlas source baseline uses lower POC tie, upper VA tie and stop when both immediate adjacent masses are zero; the corrected complete expansion can cross empty rows. A highest-density disconnected set is a different statistic. No mean or median is called POC and no Gaussian/future-coverage meaning is inferred from value fraction.

Compute nonnegative multiresolution profiles by exact coarsening and finite triangular smoothing. Kernel mass outside the fixed grid moves to explicit overflow; smoothing preserves total mass. Report local mode/plateau sets, interior valley versus boundary tail, dominance margin, local prominence, gradient edges, concentration and normalized entropy. Match modes across declared smoothing scales using overlapping support basins and export the full match relation/persistence count, not a single retrospectively selected width. Grid phase and smoothing choices have their own versions. Prominence is peak height minus the higher of the two surrounding minimum-to-higher-peak basins (boundary basins use zero); equal peaks/plateaus are retained.

For compatible normalized profiles, exact one-dimensional mass transport is sum of absolute cumulative probability differences times row width. Overflow/unpriced mass makes a full finite-distance claim unavailable. Separate raw source additions/removals/corrections from normalization: for unchanged previous mass x and added z, delta_probability = z/Mnew + x*(1/Mnew-1/Mold). Do not describe argmax movement as physical movement of already traded volume. Anchor comparisons retain shared and exclusive source contributions.

The developing-profile kernel fits expected row rates on complete compatible historical captured profiles grouped by frozen prewindow context and formation exposure; it exports raw expected mass, normalized shape and residuals with support and pooled fallback. The entire recipe/training capture set is retained. Pure arithmetic returns unpublished state; public inference uses actual F11 TemporalFold, exact training reads, original row/date/target requests and exact state reconstruction. No image/temporal neural model is claimed from this compact kernel; further learned encoders remain explicit model/OOF prerequisites.

## Source bar proxies

Actual shared bars may feed explicitly labeled proxy variants: uniform high-low continuous-overlap allocation (Atlas), equal-inclusive-row allocation (declared alternative), PIN066/077 body-direction plus doubled equally split wick weights, close or HLC3 price with volume, and EMA5 source-volume smoothing. Proxies never claim actual aggressor geography. PIN066/077 formula: denominator body+2*upper_wick+2*lower_wick, body share assigned to candle direction, wick shares halved between estimated sides, each share distributed by geometric bin overlap. Its flat-bar loss, bottom-bin POC unavailable and threshold-bin boundary defect are retained as diagnostic source-bug behavior, separate from corrected mass-conserving geometry. Growing-high/low adaptive source grids are a named source representation and cannot masquerade as the fixed-grid challenger.

Daily OI-change allocation is a separate report-derived proxy with its own units/publication/revision identity, not contracts traded or intraday signed flow. Repeated stale daily values cannot create repeated new observations. Missing original source formulas (automatic TPO grid, C-score, undisclosed minor-node/DOM rules) remain unavailable replicas with exact missing requirements. IB Pine statistics and source association constants remain individually catalogued hypotheses using actual C01/F09/V01 formation and ordered-label ports; no source hit table is imported as calibrated probability. Preserve every source clock, boundary, percentile, tie, current-included versus prior-only scale and display-invariance distinction in the source-variant table.

## M05 side geometry

Use exactly the same anchor/grid and optional authenticated fixed/soft M02 cohort weights. Keep B/S/U nonnegative, Delta=B-S and absolute-delta magnitude separately. Local unknown envelopes are Delta +/- U; full true bounds require complete source history. Raw ratios include an explicit zero-denominator status. Shrunk contrast is (B-S)/(B+S+U+2*lambda), lambda nonnegative fixed pseudo-mass with positive denominator. It is descriptive, not a calibrated side probability. Preserve positive and negative peak sets, cumulative imbalance, normalized side CDFs, overlap=sum min(pB,pS), total-variation separation and one-dimensional side transport where both sides have support. A canceled net shelf retains its two-sided mass. Cohort channels reconcile both hard and soft partitions without duplicating prints or asserting participant identity.

## M06 TPO, occupancy and dwell

Fixed bracket selections come from actual F03 clocks and source coverage. Exact visits use whole trades; a row counts once per bracket regardless of repeated visits or volume. OHLC range-filled visitation and chart-bar letters are distinct source proxy definitions. Keep bracket-by-row incidence, completed/provisional/missing bracket support, first/last visits, contiguous support runs, revisit counts/gaps and formation exposure. Session/holiday completion uses actual calendar endpoints. An unfinished or missing bracket cannot certify a completed single print or untouched level.

Single-occupancy rows and consecutive extreme tails are distinct from interior single-print regions. Same-letter tails and single-occupancy tails are separate TP3 interpretations. Minimum completed/occupied bracket counts are explicit; Atlas five-period display readiness does not erase computed raw counts. Prior/weekly IB comes from actual C01/F09 named formation, including source daily resets versus separately declared combined first-two-trading-day weekly IB. It is not rebuilt from a duplicate TPO-specific range state.

Sparse trade observations identify visits but do not identify true between-print residence. Last-observed interpolation with a frozen stale cap exports an estimate and unassigned duration. Its true continuous residence lower bound is zero and upper bound is available observation exposure unless a stronger observed quote process identifies it. No interval crossing an outage receives fabricated no-trade/dwell evidence. Actual M09 fresh quote capture may supply separately named displayed-quote occupancy. Same TPO counts with different chronological visits retain different path features.

## M07 exact VWAP and robust alternatives

Use exact integer/Fraction sums of q, pq and p^2q, stable variance (M*sum_p2q-sum_pq^2)/M^2 and explicit zero-volume output. Exact updates/downdates and union/difference source contributions reproduce bounded full reference recomputation; deleting the last print clears current moments. Standard deviation/bands use a retained Decimal precision50 context with tolerance1e-12 where irrational; variance and weighted empirical quantiles remain exact. Empirical quantile uses first whole-size cumulative mass reaching p*M, with p0/min and p1/max. Weighted median, median absolute deviation around the weighted median, winsorized center and asymmetric quantile bands remain distinct from mean/SD.

Source SD multipliers1/2/2.5/3 and percentage bands remain separately named; no confidence-interval claim. Exact trade grouping must be bar-resolution invariant; HLC3/close times bar-volume is explicitly a proxy. Same-anchor slope/rolling change cannot use reset jumps; cross-anchor difference remains an explicitly relational measurement. Source PIN069 new-high06–09 reanchors are causal and distinct from session-start, completed-range or confirmed-swing anchors. A fresh anchor uses its own first eligible data, never a stale old-anchor value, and display toggles cannot prevent updates. Source fixed GMT-4 and actual New York clock variants stay separate.

PIN069 moving-anchor residuals retain historical A_t=(RTH_VWAP_t+high_anchor_VWAP_t)/2 and d_t=source_t-A_t at each actual publication. Source RMS=sqrt(sum(q*d^2)/sum q), positive/negative RMS, zero-centered median(abs d), unweighted linearly interpolated quantiles10/25/75/90 (requires two observations), and weighted mean deviation added to current A are named honestly. Centered variance/MAD and fixed-anchor recomputation are separate comparisons; old deviations never silently recenter on today's anchor. Actual anchor-to-anchor differences decompose exactly into each member's p*(qA/MA-qB/MB) with shared/exclusive membership retained.

## M13 footprints and chronology

Exact footprints use common capture of actual F09 bar publications, the M04 frozen grid and M05 side channels. Same-price B(k)/S(k) differs from diagonal B(k)/S(k-1), with the symmetric sell comparison. Preserve source ratios3,4,3.5 and4.5 as different interpretations and stack lengths2/3. Zero opposing quantity is an explicit policy (require observed opposition or qualify after minimum numerator), not infinite confidence. Unknown side gives observed ratios plus conservative compatible ratio/qualification bounds. Consecutive numeric grid rows are required for stacks; untraded gaps are never compressed away.

Record signed/absolute peaks, concentration, body/wick/tail location and last print/order evidence. Final body/wick geometry requires actual completed bar publication; developing geometry is labeled provisional. Identical final footprints may have different ordered prefix slices/CVD excursions. Prefix publication uses actual prefix captures and completion, not retrospective slicing with backdated availability. Finite multiscale coarsening, integrated contrast and fixed Haar pair means/differences expose compact spatial channels; retained chronological slices keep temporal information. Low-rank/tensor learned encoders remain separate fitted-model comparisons requiring actual training/OOF, not a relabeling of Haar summaries. Sparse zero tails do not prove an auction is complete or identify absorption, icebergs or trapped inventory.

## Finite work, review and evidence

Bounds before copying/replay: source inputs4096, grid rows4096, anchors256, profiles256, brackets1024, scales32, bands32, contexts256, training rows1024, retained bytes8MiB; identities UTF-8 bytes256. Explicitly bound requested row spans and Cartesian scale/prefix work, not only occupied rows. Stage updates before committing and retain old versions; no silent eviction. Work counters report actual source visits, hashes, copied bytes and kernel/row operations. Reference scans are not claimed constant time.

All hand cases are fixed before candidate implementation. After all M01–M13 initial implementation, conduct one whole batch static review, one consolidated repair and one shared resource-supervised verification. Every case/source row receives narrow assertion dispositions and remaining work. P3 calibration/support, fitted model competitions/interactions, fixed-opportunity downstream utility, complete one-account/one-mini policy economics and genuine future captures require their actual data and temporal evidence. No coverage or source statement proves economic success. No orders, purchases, accounts or messages to others are part of this work.
common_contract_text:
# M01–M13 shared measurement evidence port (draft; no candidate execution)

Owner: /root/f04_merge_tests. New file: src/trading_research/measurements/common.py. Preserve existing Trade, TradeView, TransactionTapeView, WindowCoverage, CausalBar and M12 ReferencePrice wires.

## Minimal public API

`capture_trade_window(view, *, instrument: str, start: int, end: int, cut: int, published_at: int, definition_version: str, aggregation_unit: str, coverage: WindowCoverage, max_inputs: int = 4096, max_bytes: int = 8388608) -> CapturedTradeWindow`

`validate_trade_window(captured, view) -> None` recomputes the capture against the actual view and requires exact value equality. Consumers using a detached capture must call this at their admission boundary; a caller-supplied hash or dataclass is not certification. Capturing requires exact supported existing TradeLedger or TransactionTapeView, not arbitrary protocol objects returning invented facts. F05 remains preferred; legacy TradeLedger is explicitly labeled provider-domain-unavailable.

`CapturedTradeWindow` is frozen and contains only `window: MeasurementWindow`, `trades: tuple[Trade,...]`. No duplicate tape per cohort. `MeasurementWindow` is frozen with:

- instrument, start, end, cut, published_at, definition_version, aggregation_unit.
- source_kind (`f05_transaction` or `legacy_trade`), source_domains: sorted tuples of actual F05 root-key (provider,dataset,publisher_or_venue,channel,source_session); legacy empty with explicit unavailable status and cannot claim cross-feed source order.
- source_versions: sorted `(root identity, source content version)` tuples from all in-window actual resolved F05 rows, including explicitly ineligible rows (legacy uses trade.id/source_content_version); correction_ids: sorted actual impacted delta/correction identities; contribution_hash: digest of complete selected Trade records (not IDs alone).
- coverage: actual immutable WindowCoverage, coverage_id: its full digest, observed_duration_ns; support_status (`complete`, `partial`, `unobserved`) derived solely from coverage spans and selected source history; history_complete boolean derived from both, never accepted as an independent input.
- eligible_volume, excluded_volume (known F05 ineligible mass; legacy zero), buy_volume, sell_volume, unknown_volume, unpriced_volume, print_count: recomputed exact integers. Signed observed uncertainty remains `signed +/- unknown`; finite true-flow bounds only if history_complete.
- order_exact: recomputed within event-time ties from unique non-null order, separate from history completeness; covered_print_count: counts prints in coverage spans. A trade outside declared observed spans is a support conflict and fails capture, rather than silently counting its volume over unrelated exposure.
- max_inputs, max_bytes: exact admitted bounds. `id` digest covers every field including actual publication, source provenance and bounds.

Time semantics: requested interval is [start,end), usable event prefix is event_at >= start, event_at < end and event_at <= cut (never calculate cut+1 outside the timestamp domain); cut >= start; publication >= cut; every event known_at <= cut and event_at <= cut. Coverage instrument/start/end must exactly match; coverage.known_at <= cut. WindowCoverage already requires span right <= coverage.known_at <= cut; complete window requires its actual complete coverage through end. Quiet complete empty-window history is certified solely by actual coverage, never by vacuous source-row truth. Partial windows carry partial support and no false completion. Quiet but completely covered windows have zero counts/rates and complete history; zero covered duration is unobserved and rates unavailable. Coverage version cannot be reused with inconsistent bytes within a publishing service.

Input bounds: validate finite positive integer bounds and exact admitted view types before any capture materialization. Legacy view checks len(trades)+len(corrections) <= max_inputs and its configured max_events finite; F05 checks len(ledger.deltas) <= max_inputs and its declared max_records/max_bytes finite before asof/changes. The actual ledger already has a bounded tuple/dict representation. Check tuple lengths before copying/sorting; reject over-bound coverage spans/source domains/corrections before building outputs. Bound individual identity strings and serialized output bytes; no arbitrary generators are consumed. These bounds are conservative on total retained source contributions, including outside-window rows, so asof cannot allocate an unbounded hidden history. Exact capacity succeeds, one over fails without mutation.

F05 unresolved condition eligibility fails explicitly before producing an eligible capture; excluded known-ineligible mass and its source versions stay visible. F05 source domain: infer from actual ResolvedTransaction root keys and require one common fully declared domain within each time tie before trusting source order (matches existing TransactionTapeView). Distinct domains remain explicitly listed, with order ambiguity, never fabricated cross-domain ordering. Aggregation-unit mismatch is a hard error even when numeric flow matches. No standalone-trade plus MBP-trade merging at this port: F05 reconciliation must precede it.

Corrections: capture asof(cut) and changes(cut) from actual view; old capture values remain immutable. A replacement moving across an anchor changes the current source versions and affected correction IDs even if numeric sum is unchanged. `validate_trade_window` uses historical cut, so later corrections do not invalidate genuinely old evidence. Restore is recomputation from actual restored source ledger plus exact original request and coverage, then compare receipt; no independent mutable certificate registry required.

F09 shared-bar adapter: `capture_bar_window(engine, publication_version_id, *, view, aggregation_unit, published_at, max_inputs=4096, max_bytes=8388608)` resolves the actual retained time-bar publication and its exact WindowRequest through `SharedBarEngine.window_publication`. It recaptures the actual source and coverage at the bar's frozen cut and validates raw domain, requested start/end, all selected IDs/content versions/corrections and exact summary volume/priced volume/unknown/buy/sell/OHLC where identifiable. Reject forged, future, wrong-definition, wrong-source and activity-bar publications through this time-bar adapter. Activity membership has its separate whole-event adapter. The returned MeasurementWindow adds `source_bar_version` (None for direct trade capture) to its complete identity. Store the engine/publication request only as a private revalidation recipe, excluded from canonical payload; public consumers revalidate through actual retained publication plus source. This adapter is required by M04/M06/M07/M13; no legacy CausalBar is accepted as its own proof.

## Hand cases to register

1. +5,-2,+4 known exact source => buy9,sell2,unknown0,signed7; one second covered => count3/sec and quantity11/sec. Independent dimensions raw ticks/contracts/ns.
2. Same prints after switching aggregation unit or raw instrument => reject; same numeric +7 under another legitimate source version => different receipt identity. Equal data/cut with publication +1ns => different receipt identity.
3. Unknown print size4 plus known+3: observed signed bounds[-1,7]; complete tape finite; partial coverage history false and true signed bounds unavailable. Covered quiet one-second window => zero rate; uncovered window => unavailable rate.
4. Original +5 in anchorA, corrected at cut20 to event in anchorB: cut10 A=5, B=0 preserved; cut20 A=0,B=5, both current impacts recorded. Restored source ledger reproduces each captured prefix exactly.
5. Same timestamp +10,-20,+10 without shared ordering domain => close0, order ambiguous; source domains retained. Same printed numbers with valid unique local order => true H10/L-10.
6. max_inputs exactly retained count and exact output-byte capacity pass; one additional source record / one output byte less fails before consumer mutation. Reject unsized iterables and massive coverage tuple before copying.

This is a design proposal only. Registration, implementation, one whole-M-batch review, one consolidated repair and one shared verification remain in that order. Learned support/alpha/economics/future evidence remain gated.
anchor_contract_text:
# Shared F10 anchor capture for M04–M07/M13 and M12

Pre-registration proposal only; owner /root/f04_batch_review, intended new file `src/trading_research/measurements/anchored.py`. No source, graph, or candidate execution.

`capture_anchor(graph: ObjectGraph, *, anchor_version_id: str, instrument: Instrument, cut: int, published_at: int, definition_version: str, max_evidence: int = 4096, max_bytes: int = 8388608) -> AnchoredCapture`

Frozen result: exact `AnchorVersion`, tuple of exact `EvidenceVersion` in the anchor's declared order, exact raw `Instrument`, input cut, actual publication, wrapper definition, graph registry definition digest, and canonical lineage-closure digest. Its own id covers all fields. Validate exact supported ObjectGraph and bounded instrument/identity/configuration before materialization; reject overlarge evidence tuple before fetching members. Every evidence is purpose MEASUREMENT, support OBSERVED, same exact Instrument, and event/known time <= cut. Anchor confirmed_at/known_at <= cut; published_at >= cut; instrument valid at the capture cut. Use actual `graph.get_version` values, never a caller-constructed AnchorVersion/EvidenceVersion receipt. `graph.lineage_closure((anchor_version_id,), cut)` verifies that the immutable version and all source dependencies were actually published by the frozen cut; graph already bounds closure. Store digest, not a second graph. Wrapper additionally bounds serialized result bytes.

`validate_anchor(captured: AnchoredCapture, graph: ObjectGraph) -> None` performs the identical historical recapture request and exact equality. Later corrections do not alter genuinely historical capture. This certifies exact historical anchor provenance; it does **not** claim that an old anchor remains the current live supported head. Current object status/birth/TTL stays solely with existing F10 `object_asof`, `active_set` and publication support checks. No duplicate graph or local fabricated expiry rule.

Formula-specific membership remains explicit: a consumer must additionally recapture the actual trade window (shared common.py), compare interval/instrument/aggregation units, and bind the required evidence `content_digest` to the full immutable captured source/member descriptor required by that formula. Merely matching IDs, a start/end pair, or generic "certified=True" is insufficient. Anchor formation evidence and trade accumulation evidence can be different; one is not silently substituted for the other. Each formula registers its exact member digest mapping.

F10 AnchorVersion requires start <= end <= confirmed_at <= known_at. Consequently a future-ended planned session range cannot masquerade as a sealed anchor at session open. An early certified/scheduled open can use an actual zero-span anchor at its known event time, or an evidence-only F10 birth. Accumulation interval is separately requested and may remain developing; no fabricated C01 sealed range. For a composite profile, each constituent has its own captured anchor and trade capture; retain declared chronological constituents, reject duplicate anchor versions, deduplicate exact overlapping trade IDs, reject conflicting repeated-ID bytes. Disjoint windows stay disjoint; no fill across their gaps.

Independent public cases: unpublished/future anchor fails closure; wrong evidence purpose or exact instrument fails; changed evidence bytes with same display price changes identity; correction known20 leaves historical cut10 receipt unchanged; latest active object at20 with unrepaired old evidence remains F10 dirty/ineligible; zero-span open anchor at10 admitted at10 while attempted futureend20 at10 cannot satisfy AnchorVersion; graph born_at and TTL unchanged across capture/publication and refresh; same trade in overlapping constituent windows contributes once, same ID with changed content rejected. One-over evidence/byte bound rejects before downstream mutation.
remaining: Initial implementation of all M01-M13 then one combined review/repair/shared verification
Source-specific downstream forecast/management/statistical/economic assertions remain distinct from deterministic measurements
Original source deficiencies remain explicit; no whole-source/phase/economic closure
